name: China Automotive Engineering Research Institute Co., Ltd.
summary: China Automotive Engineering Research Institute Co., Ltd. engages in automotive technology services and equipment manufacturing in China and internationally. The company develops automotive and related product technologies; and offers research and development, testing and evaluation, product certification, software tools, testing equipment, and technical consulting services for automobiles.
